units.source_text: 一个十九二十岁的乡村艺妓，理应是不会弹出一手好三弦琴的。

en.t: A country geisha of nineteen or twenty should hardly have been able to play the shamisen so well.

units.source_text: 她虽只是在宴席上弹弹，可弹得简直跟在舞台上的一样！

en.t: Though she was only playing at a banquet, she played as if she were on a stage.

units.source_text: 岛村心想：这大概只不过是自己对山峦的一种感伤罢了。

en.t: Shimamura thought that it was probably nothing more than his own sentimentality toward the mountains.

units.source_text: 驹子时而故意只念念歌词，时而说这儿太慢那儿又麻烦，就跳了过去。

en.t: Komako would sometimes deliberately recite only the lyrics, and sometimes say that one part was too slow or another too troublesome, and skip over it.

units.source_text: 可是她渐渐地像着了迷了，声音又高亢起来。

en.t: But little by little she seemed to become possessed, and her voice rose higher and more intense.

units.source_text: 这弹拨的弦音要飘荡到什么地方去呢？

en.t: Where would the sound of these plucked strings drift away to?

units.source_text: 岛村有点惊呆了，给自己壮胆似地曲着双臂，把头枕在上面躺了下来。

en.t: Shimamura was somewhat stunned, and, as if to brace himself, bent both arms, rested his head on them, and lay down.
